text_block_list.text:
One day, when I visited a shrine with Tap 
Dance City, who was in a slump...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Failed again?! Urrgh! This is way too 
hard!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That's a huge geoglyph. You drew that 
really well!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not a drawing, it's a magic circle! 
I'm practicing my 'Cheer-Up Magic'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"The higher up you draw a magic circle, 
the more vitality you can gather from it!— 
That's what it says in the grimoire!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I've been messing up nonstop! I 
can't believe this!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Um... The pattern drawn inside the magic 
circle looks familiar. Wait—is that 
cursive script for "vitalis"?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sweep! We'll help too. With this 
magic, we should be able to help out!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's divide up the tasks! I'll 
call the shots from up in the tree. 
Trainer, you're on magic circle drawing 
duty!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm? Then what about me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Focus on chanting the spell. Put all your 
feelings into it so it succeeds."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Alright, this time for sure, 
I'm definitely going to make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
M-My body feels all warm inside! Does that 
mean it worked!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Isn't that wonderful! A romantic 
wish, and the willpower to pursue it— 
that's what made the magic work!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What a witch! Thanks to her, even I'm 
feeling energized now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! You should be thanking the genius 
magical girl, Sweepy!

Perhaps thanks to the blessing of the 
"Cheer-Up Magic," Tap Dance City got her 
groove back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eek!? You've gotta be kidding! It was 
totally sunny just a minute ago!?
choice_data_list:
My magic circle, after I worked so hard to 
draw it...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oh no!! For now, run under some shelter!

Perhaps due to the failure of the 
"Cheer-Up Magic," Tap Dance City continued 
to feel out of sorts...
